item.title: DevMemory: A Structured Memory Management Architecture for Persistent Knowledge in AI Coding Agents
item.description: AI coding agents operate without persistent memory; useful outputs produced in one session are unavailable in the next, and information from one project never transfers to another. item.title: Civilization Engineering A Generative Architecture for Building Civilizations through Text, Models, Knowledge, Institutions, Memory, and Intergenerational Handoff
item.description: Description Civilization Engineering develops a systematic framework for studying how civilizations can be intentionally shaped, tested, preserved, revised, and transmitted across generations. The central proposition is that civilizations are not produced only by governments, technologies, economies, or historical accidents. item.title: Generative debunking of climate misinformation
item.description: Abstract Misinformation is a persistent roadblock to progress on climate change, and the ubiquitous, rapid spread of misinformation means that manual solutions are inadequate to meet the scale of the problem. item.title: Adaptive emergency braking for highway safety: a simulation framework for performance and reliability evaluation
item.description: Highway safety is a critical concern for automated vehicles, particularly in dynamic and high-risk scenarios requiring precise braking and trajectory adjustments. This paper presents a comprehensive evaluation of an Automated Emergency Braking (AEB) system designed to enhance safety in diverse highway conditions. item.description: Infection with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) is currently incurable because the virus integrates into the host genome of long-lived memory CD4+ T cells and can persist in a transcriptionally silent state, known as latency. item.title: DoubleAgents: Human-Agent Alignment in a Socially Embedded Workflow
item.description: Aligning agentic AI with user intent is critical for delegating complex, socially embedded tasks, yet user preferences are often implicit, evolving, and difficult to specify upfront.
